description: This file defines Express routes for managing application deployment records, including CRUD operations and a specialized endpoint for resolving project names based on project IDs. It includes in-memory caching for project name lookups to optimize performance.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a project name from the cache if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a project name in the cache with an expiration timestamp.

methods.name: extractNormalizedProjectId
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a project ID from various payload shapes.
